faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before enrolling
faq.a1: No! Our courses are designed for beginners. Web Development starts from zero with HTML/CSS, while Pro Tracks begin with the fundamentals of each language.
faq.q2: How does the hybrid format work?
faq.a2: You can attend every class online or in-person in Kamëz, Tirana. All sessions are recorded and accessible 24/7 through our portal.
faq.a3: Web Development and all Pro Tracks last 2 months, with 6 weeks of lessons plus 4 weeks of project work — 12 sessions and 4 portfolio projects total.
faq.a4: Yes! Every student receives a recognized certificate upon successful completion of the course and projects.
faq.a5: Payment is made before the course starts. We accept bank transfers and online payments. Launch price is 99€ for Pro Tracks; pricing for Web Development is coming soon.
faq.q6: Are there job opportunities after the course?
faq.a6: We help with CV preparation, interview practice and connections to partner companies. Your 4 portfolio projects serve as proof of your skills.
faq.a7: Just a laptop with internet. We provide all tools, libraries and necessary access for free.
faq.q8: Can I change programs after enrolling?
faq.a8: Yes, you can switch programs up to the first week of the course at no extra cost.
